title: Construct a counter-free distance-L clean conveyor with an exponential admitted-record latency tail
statement: For each ofL^2 streams put three-state exclusion sitesz=0..L with unit arrivals into an empty entrance, rate-mu occupied-to-empty bondmoves and a rate-mu final emission. Particles cannot overtake and sources never pause; occupied-entrance arrivals are explicitly deleted. Letn=L+1. Given the ENTIRE history at a tagged admission, at mostn-1 particles precede it; clearing predecessors right-to-left and then the tag needs at mostn^2 designated successful moves. Strong-Markov proposal waiting times give D_tag stochastically<=sum_(k=1)^(n^2)Exp(mu). Exponential Markov atmu/2 gives P(D_tag>2n^2/mu|F_admission)<=exp[-(1-log2)*n^2], uniformly in payload/history. ExpectedL^2T arrivals then yield P(any admitted-byT record exceeds ell_L=2(L+1)^2/mu)<=L^2T*exp[-(1-log2)*(L+1)^2]<=CTexp(-cL^2). ExactlyL^2(L+1) sites, constantstates/range and empty initializationO(L^3); including disabled proposals, clean W_T~Poisson[L^2*(1+mu*(L+1))*T] with upper-tail exp[-s^2/(2*(mean+s/3))],workO_mu(L^3T). These are FAULT-FREE admitted-record order/transport/work results; no noisy payload reliability or prescribed joint admission-loss law is established.
